name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
officialName: Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis

flag.description: A black diagonal band edged in yellow runs from the lower hoist to the upper fly, carrying two white five-pointed stars; the upper hoist triangle is green and the lower fly triangle red.
flag.symbolism: Green represents the fertile land, yellow the sunshine, black the African heritage, and red the struggle against slavery and colonialism; the two stars stand for hope and liberty.

hook: Saint Kitts and Nevis: a black diagonal sash with two white stars, one for each island, between green and red triangles.
trivia: Saint Kitts and Nevis is the smallest sovereign state in the Americas by both area and population.
The flag was designed by Edrice Lewis, whose entry won a national competition before independence in 1983.
